design_choice_and_rationale.chosen_mechanism: Stored candidate-index columns (summary_index JSONB, summary_rev BIGINT) on registry.entries maintained synchronously on every write path via BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF payload trigger entries_strategy_summary_index_tg (pantheon_registry_summary_index_build + pantheon_registry_summary_rev_seq) and idempotently backfilled in bounded 1,000-row batches at store bootstrap, paired with a single-flight in-process Phase 1 candidate-index cache validated on every read by one cheap aggregate query (SELECT count(*), coalesce(max(summary_rev), 0)::bigint, coalesce(sum(summary_rev), 0)::bigint FROM registry.entries WHERE summary_index IS NOT NULL) and updated incrementally after writes via partial index entries_strategy_summary_idx (WHERE summary_index IS NOT NULL AND summary_rev > %s).
why_both_stored_columns_and_stamp_valida: 1. Eliminates payload detoasting and 42 JSON path evaluations in PostgreSQL: storing the pre-projected ~948-byte summary_index JSONB and 8-byte summary_rev BIGINT on registry.entries drops Postgres Phase 1 buffer reads on 9,416 strategy_spec rows (+ 524 other rows) from 123,774 shared buffers / 1,532.74 ms (legacy payload || '{}' scan) down to 1,366 shared buffers / 78.49 ms on a cold stored-column scan and 6 shared buffers / 0.167 ms on a post-write delta scan.

2. Eliminates 8x concurrent Python JSON decode and candidate-dict allocation amplification: even with a 78.5 ms stored-column SQL read, 8 concurrent cold reads decoding 9,416 JSON objects in Python without a shared Phase 1 cache still take 4,092.05 ms wall time and 368.16 MiB peak RSS (+340.55 MiB delta). Adding the single-flight, stamp-validated in-process Phase 1 cache (validated on every read by one 3.03 ms aggregate query over summary_rev and updated incrementally by summary_rev > max_rev) collapses 8 concurrent cold reads on a fresh Registry process to 1 SQL full load + 7 stamp-validated cache hits: wall time drops from 5,529.41 ms to 965.63 ms (5.7x faster) and peak RSS (VmHWM) drops from 375.40 MiB (+347.03 MiB delta) to 120.64 MiB (+93.21 MiB delta, 67.9% lower peak RSS, well within DEV_MEM_LIMIT_REGISTRY=768m).

3. Immediate write visibility across processes and workers: because the BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF payload trigger assigns a strictly increasing summary_rev from pantheon_registry_summary_rev_seq on every write path (whether via create_if_absent, put, _cas_entry, create_with_receipt, register_strategy_spec_revision, or another worker/service sharing the database) and every read checks (count(*), max(summary_rev), sum(summary_rev)) against the database before serving cached rows, any insert, update, state advance, persona binding change, data_scope change, or delete is guaranteed visible on the very next read.

sql_phase1_reads.stamp_query: SELECT count(*), coalesce(max(summary_rev), 0)::bigint, coalesce(sum(summary_rev), 0)::bigint FROM registry.entries WHERE summary_index IS NOT NULL
sql_phase1_reads.full_load_query: SELECT record_id, summary_rev, summary_index FROM registry.entries WHERE summary_index IS NOT NULL ORDER BY updated_at ASC, record_id ASC
sql_phase1_reads.delta_load_query: SELECT record_id, summary_rev, summary_index FROM registry.entries WHERE summary_index IS NOT NULL AND summary_rev > %s ORDER BY updated_at ASC, record_id ASC

write_paths_keeping_summary_index_curren: PostgreSQL BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF payload trigger entries_strategy_summary_index_tg -> pantheon_registry_summary_index_tg_fn() -> pantheon_registry_summary_index_build(NEW.payload) + nextval('pantheon_registry_summary_rev_seq')
PostgresRegistryStore.backfill_strategy_summary_index (idempotent bounded bootstrap backfill for pre-existing rows with summary_index IS NULL)

runtime_budget.manifest_entry_name: registry.entries stored summary_index / summary_rev columns, partial index entries_strategy_summary_idx, and stamp-validated Phase 1 index cache
runtime_budget.cadence: DDL and idempotent batched backfill run once at store bootstrap; trigger entries_strategy_summary_index_tg runs once per registry.entries INSERT or UPDATE OF payload (~300 strategy_spec writes/day on hosted); stamp validation query runs once per strategy_summary_page read (3.0 ms); delta index query runs only for rows with summary_rev > cached_max_rev
runtime_budget.growth_per_day: about 300 new strategy_spec rows/day x (947.6 B summary_index + 8 B summary_rev + ~24 B partial index tuple) = ~294 KB/day (~107 MB/year); 0 B net logical growth on in-place updates after VACUUM; 0 B/day net in-process cache growth beyond the strategy_spec row set and SUMMARY_INDEX_MAX_TENANT_VIEWS = 16 cap
runtime_budget.cap: 1 summary_index JSONB (~948 B) and 1 summary_rev BIGINT (8 B) per strategy_spec row (NULL for non-strategy_spec rows); bootstrap backfill bounded by SUMMARY_INDEX_BACKFILL_BATCH_SIZE = 1000 and SUMMARY_INDEX_BACKFILL_MAX_BATCHES = 50; in-process Phase 1 cache bounded to SUMMARY_INDEX_MAX_TENANT_VIEWS = 16 tenant views and 4 winner sub-cache entries per stamp
runtime_budget.cleanup: stored columns and partial index tuples follow registry.entries row lifecycle with PostgreSQL VACUUM; non-strategy_spec rows set summary_index = NULL and summary_rev = NULL via trigger; in-process cache evicts oldest tenant view beyond SUMMARY_INDEX_MAX_TENANT_VIEWS = 16, clears stale _winners_cache when DB stamp changes, and supports full eviction via invalidate_strategy_summary_index_cache(full=True)
